description.p: 5DO is a source-available 3DO Interactive Multiplayer emulator derived from the FreeDO core. It ships a desktop application with a game library, BIOS manager, save states, cheats, TAS movies, RetroAchievements, and a headless command-line tool for automation and verification.

ul.li: Accurate ARM60, CLIO, MADAM, DSP, and CD-ROM emulation with a 378-title compatibility set.
OpenGL, GLES, Vulkan, and Direct3D 11 presentation with Accurate, Nearest, SharpBilinear, Bicubic, xBR, HQx, MMPX, and FSR 1.0 filters.
Game library with cover art, metadata, cheats, and per-game profiles.
Eight-player input profiles, evdev gamepads, lightguns, and scripted input timelines.
ISO, BIN/CUE, CHD, CDI, and NRG disc images, plus disc conversion.

description.p: 5DO does not include a BIOS ROM or any game images. Users must supply legally obtained files.

description.p: Rolling autosave with startup resume and validated disc/BIOS matching, plus direct ZIP/7z ISO, BIN, and CUE+BIN containers across the desktop library and CLI.

CD-DA extraction to WAV with `disc audio`, `disc verify` progress and mixed-mode track totals, and the optical collection/BIOS verification evidence. Retains physical CD-DA, disc read-error, Steam Deck, Arcade CRT, and optical-drive fixes.

Physical CD-DA playback from a host optical drive, CD-DA end addressing follow the disc track table, damaged or failing disc reads are reported to the guest instead of stopping emulation, and a failed screenshot or save-slot thumbnail write no longer crashes the UI.

Steam Deck/SteamOS first-run setup with a larger BIOS layout, the Arcade CRT filter on OpenGL/GLES, Vulkan, Direct3D 11, and the software fallback, and fixes for Windows physical optical-drive discovery, JIT soft-reset state, and single-pad PBUS input.

Packaging and diagnostics bug-fix release: Windows bundles include the app-local MSVC runtime OpenAL Soft needs, AppImage update metadata resolves the next release, cover-catalog HTTP failures fall back to the cached catalog, and expected user conditions no longer file bug reports.

Bug-fix release for the deep-review pass: CHD Mode 2 native track sectors, cropped-frame pointer and CPU presentation dimensions, atomic state/cache writes, malformed settings recovery, and shutdown handling for audio, RetroAchievements, and presentation threads.

High-resolution presentation is now a safe 2x upscale for every title, the OpenGL 480-line upload is fixed, and the Gamegun defaults keep a joypad alongside the gun. P pauses, Space toggles fast-forward, F1 connects the Gamegun, and Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen.
Bug-fix release: movie verification matches the recorded evidence again, and a partial extraction shows a clear startup message instead of a Skia crash.
Linux artifacts carry the platform and version in their file names, and the release lists a per-platform download table.
Native Metal surface on macOS, Phoenix/4DO presentation options, and GPG-signed Linux artifacts with a published keyring.
macOS arm64 GPU presentation through Vulkan/MoltenVK, a packaged GPU runtime, and self-contained single-file apphosts for every platform.
